gate_criteria_verification.criterion: G09: crash/concurrent workers cannot double-pay, double-refund or lose escrow; approved tournament and private lobby behavior remains.
gate_criteria_verification.no_double_pay: Concurrent settlement workers serialize on room lock; exactly one payout committed per seat; wallets credited once; burn recorded once
gate_criteria_verification.no_double_refund: Cancelled/voided tournaments refund entries once; second settle call or replay returns existing receipt with zero second effect
gate_criteria_verification.no_lost_escrow: Escrow equals sum of entry contributions at start; zeroed on settlement; payouts + burn equals pool; refunds equal pool; no stranded funds
gate_criteria_verification.approved_tournament_behavior: Ten seats required on public tables; automatic start only; 200-Elo cohort cap; 10% burn and 5th-place break-even; normal Elo completely independent
gate_criteria_verification.approved_private_lobby_behavior: Host-leave in LOBBY transitions to CANCELLED; guest-leave preserves room; host transfer hands ownership; pause freezes clocks without gift; restarts do not cause user leave
